context_purpose: Ensure tobacco/e-cigarette products are handed only to buyers of legal age at an unattended locker.

norm_violation_today.reason: The duty is an age check, but the operator keeps a full ID image and identity data in a pickup log, which exceeds what the age purpose needs.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Nothing for age gating; the operator cannot later prove to an auditor who was checked unless it keeps a proof receipt or log.

transmission_check.reason: The age-check duty is a legal one, but whether a regulator accepts a wallet proof instead of a retained ID record at an unattended point is unknown to me.

context_purpose: Offer a congregation group fare to members of a given temple and confirm eligibility.

norm_violation_today.reason: Collecting ID numbers, believer-card photos and register pages that expose other members goes well beyond a yes/no on membership and reveals religious affiliation.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Nothing for the fare; the agent loses a convenient contact list and any ID needed for travel insurance, which is a separate duty.

transmission_check.reason: The person hands over data voluntarily for a discount, with no legal duty requiring the full register or card photos.

context_purpose: Locate and serve legal papers on a company director so that civil proceedings can continue.

norm_violation_today.reason: Service of process is a legitimate purpose, but circulating a combined dossier of person, role and home address among staff and outside agents widens the recipients beyond need.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The server still needs an actual address to deliver, so the split only moves who holds it; some party must eventually combine person and address.

transmission_check.reason: Service rules and court address-lookup powers exist, but I cannot say whether they allow a split-relay design instead of a compiled file.

context_purpose: Pre-screen walk-in day labourers for high-place work so unqualified workers are not sent to contractors.

norm_violation_today.reason: ID, address and certificate photos are broadcast to a LINE group of dozens before any employment exists, far beyond the contractor who finally hires.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Nothing for pre-screening; the hiring contractor still needs full identity once the worker is hired.

transmission_check.reason: The check exists to confirm safety training and the legal duty to verify rests with the final employer, so a validity proof at the hall is not blocked.

context_purpose: Reduce the risk of embezzlement by a volunteer who will handle temple donation money.

norm_violation_today.reason: A full criminal-record certificate and ID copy shown to the whole committee reveals unrelated entries beyond the fraud question.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Nothing for the narrow fraud question; the committee loses context on other offences it might informally weigh.

transmission_check.reason: The committee has no legal duty to collect the record; it asks as a trust measure, so a narrower proof is allowed if the candidate agrees.

context_purpose: Issue a children's reading card to a child's legal guardian under the library's age limit.

norm_violation_today.reason: Copying household registers and ID numbers of adult and child collects addresses and family details a library card does not need.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Informal guardians such as grandparents are not in the register, and the library may still need a way to contact the guardian.

transmission_check.reason: Cards are a voluntary service, but whether library or city rules require retaining ID copies for borrower records is unknown to me.

context_purpose: Confirm that the person consenting to emergency treatment is the patient's valid chosen proxy.

norm_violation_today.reason: Reading the directive is justified in an emergency, but keeping photocopies of proxy ID and health card is likely more than needed; the clinical team legitimately sees the content.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The team also needs the substantive treatment preferences in the directive, and a live revocation check is required.

transmission_check.reason: Consent rules, as I understand them, oblige the hospital to read and keep the directive and consent paperwork, so a bare proxy proof would not replace it.

context_purpose: Confirm that applicants hold a current food business permit before entering them in the slot draw.

norm_violation_today.reason: A permit stack with ID numbers filed in a cabinet exceeds the need to see that a permit is not expired.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Nothing for the draw; the committee loses a paper copy for later audit unless a proof receipt is kept.

transmission_check.reason: The committee collects to allocate stalls, but whether market or local rules require a retained permit copy for audit is unknown to me.
